text:
maya: Heads-up, CI perf job 3617 shows p95 token latency ~2.3x higher on euw-a10-1 after merge of PR #3617. CI artifacts: https://ci.internal.redwood/jobs/3617 :eyes:
ci-bot: [perf-job] job 3617 finished — p50 +10%, p95 +230%. Artifacts: https://ci.internal.redwood/artifacts/3617/perf-summary.json
sam: Can you paste profiler snapshot / flamegraph? Also which cluster config (A10 vs L4 vs H100)?
maya: quick paste from artifacts (truncated):
```
profile: p95=210ms -> 480ms
kernel_selector: commit=abc123 (PR #3617) changed fallback order
kv_cache: hit_rate 87% -> 61% on euw-a10-1
```
julian: I ran a local bisect, points at runtime/kernel_selector:abc123. That patch changed kernel choice for sparsity/seq_len combos -> falls back to slower template on A10. L4 mapping unaffected (different codepath).
chi: KV hit drop looked correlated — kv keys getting evicted faster. Noticed prefix cache TTLs didn't change though. Raw numbers from metrics: euw-a10-1 kv_gets 1.2M -> 1.3M, evictions 8k -> 42k in the same window.
sam: So two effects: (1) slower kernel on A10 for some shapes, (2) kv churn probably due to increased per-request latency causing smaller batching and more unique prefixes. L4 unaffected because its kernel route still picks optimized kernel.
maya: noisy-neighbor ruled out — GPU util ~65% stable. But network counters on euw-a10-1 show TX drops + retransmits around the same time. Maybe cross-zone throttling made KV RPCs higher-latency which cascaded.
julian: Repro locally by forcing new selector on an A10 VM — p95 jumps. Opening revert PR: https://git.internal.redwood/r/redwood/runtime/pull/3642 (WIP)
sam: Can we hotfix via remote-config toggle: runtime.use_new_kernel_selector=false for euw? If yes, we should hold rollout in other regions and apply hotfix ASAP.
eng-sre: Ack — will pause canary in euw and hold next rollout window. Scheduling a rollback if PR lands.
ci-bot: bisection result: culprit commit abc123 (author: @li), build link: https://ci.internal.redwood/bisect/abc123
maya: Action items: (1) sam to raise revert PR and patch release (2) eng-sre to hold canary+apply remote-config toggle (3) julian to validate KV eviction behavior under revert (4) maya to monitor perf dashboards and confirm p95 recovery.
sam: I'll open revert PR now and add a migration to avoid kernel fallback until we have better heuristics. ETA ~30m.
maya: thanks all :thumbsup: let's aim to have euw hotfix before EOD. We'll post updates here.
eng-sre: Rolling back canary, will post once done.
